Garage description
This paint was designed for sabotage operations in the marshland. The tanks wearing this paint were camouflaged so well that not even the leeches noticed them.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
Paint first appeared on August 26, 2010.
Prior to the Paint Separation Update, Clay was worth 250,000 crystals and could be bought at  Generalissimo.
Legacy paint description:
A paint that mostly protects against Ricochet shells and does well against Railgun and Thunder. Great for mid to long-range battles. Sports a natural masking texture that makes the tank harder to spot.
The paint was added to containers on January 14th, 2022.
